contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ M ANTONINVS AVG ARM PARTH MAX ; R/ TRPXX IMPIIII COSIII

Silver. Coin. Denarius of Marcus Aurelius (139-180), RIC volume 3 no. 164, issue of 166, Reece period 8. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: M ANTONINVS AVG ARM PARTH MAX. Reverse description: Pax standing left holding olive branch and cornucopiae. Reverse inscription: TRPXX IMPIIII COSIII. In exergue: PAX. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 2 page 306 no. 4915. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 2.62gms, die axis: 12
